shellCommands.command: ls -la /workspace/public 2>/dev/null; echo "---gitignore---"; cat /workspace/.gitignore; echo "---internet test---"; timeout 8 curl -sI https://fonts.googleapis.com/ 2>&1 | head -3 || echo "NO INTERNET or curl failed"

echo "---jsonplaceholder---"; timeout 10 curl -sI "https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts?_limit=1" 2>&1 | head -3; echo "---font css---"; timeout 10 curl -sI "https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400&display=swap" 2>&1 | head -3
ls -la /workspace/app 2>/dev/null && echo "app EXISTS" || echo "app does not exist"; ls -la /workspace/types 2>/dev/null && echo "types EXISTS" || echo "types does not exist"

rm -rf /workspace/pages && rm -f /workspace/components/AppProvider.js && echo "Removed pages dir and old AppProvider.js" && echo "---remaining structure---" && find /workspace/app /workspace/components /workspace/types /workspace/styles -type f | sort
ls /workspace/next-env.d.ts 2>/dev/null || echo "no next-env.d.ts"; echo "---tsc---"; npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -50; echo "EXIT: $?"

echo "=== Leftover Pages Router APIs in source (should be empty) ==="; grep -rnE "next/router|next/head|next/document|next/amp|getServerSideProps|getStaticProps|getStaticPaths|getInitialProps|pages/_app|pages/_document|pages/_error" /workspace/app /workspace/components /workspace/types /workspace/styles 2>/dev/null || echo "(none found)"; echo; echo "=== pages dir check ==="; ls -la /workspace/pages 2>/dev/null || echo "pages dir removed ✓"; echo; echo "=== tsconfig ==="; cat /workspace/tsconfig.json; echo; echo "=== next-env.d.ts ==="; cat /workspace/next-env.d.ts 2>/dev/null || echo "missing"

npx next start -p 3939 >/tmp/next-start.log 2>&1 &
echo "server PID: $!"
sleep 6
echo "=== GET / (home, dynamic SSR) ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "status=%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3939/
echo "=== GET /blog (ISR) ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "status=%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3939/blog
echo "=== GET /blog/1 (SSG) ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "status=%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3939/blog/1
echo "=== GET /api/posts (route handler) ==="
curl -s -w "\nstatus=%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3939/api/posts
echo "=== POST /api/posts (route handler) ==="
curl -s -w "\nstatus=%{http_code}\n" -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"title":"T","content":"C"}' http://localhost:3939/api/posts
echo "=== GET /api/posts/5 (dynamic route handler) ==="
curl -s -w "\nstatus=%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3939/api/posts/5
echo "=== GET /nonexistent (404 -> not-found) ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "status=%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3939/nonexistent
echo "=== home page contains expected content? ==="
curl -s http://localhost:3939/ | grep -o "Welcome to My Blog" | head -1
kill %1 2>/dev/null
echo "--- server log tail ---"; tail -5 /tmp/next-start.log
